verdict.rationale: HelixDB is a database with a hosted Helix Cloud offering, so a no-training data policy or opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no no-training commitment. Local and embedded run modes, row-level isolation and scoped API keys are related controls, but they are not a training-prevention capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
